newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Bourse bid tender period set for Sept 2-8.
newsitem.headline: Italy Bourse bid tender period set for Sept 2-8.

text.p: Italy's Bourse Council will meet on September 12 to examine offers made between September 2-8 and to allocate share stakes in the new private bourse company, Council chairman Francesco Cesarini told a news conference.
The Italian Treasury has set a minimum value of 40 billion lire on the stock exchange for its long-planned privatisation.
The procedure will begin on July 21 with the distribution of information material to interested parties.

The sale of shares will be carried out through competitive tender with 51 percent of the stock reserved for currently authorised bourse operators. For the rest, bids will be considered on an individual basis from investment funds, insurance companies and securities houses.
No one will be allowed to take more than a five percent stake in the new company.
Following the allocation of the stakes, a shareholders' meeting of Borsa Italiana SpA will be held by September 29.
"We have kept our promise to carry out the placement as quickly as possible," Cesarini said.
